regex/escape#

EscapedRegex converts arbitrary text into one literal Dialect 1 expression.

Version: v1.0.0

Synopsis#

let literal = "price: $5.00";
let pattern = Regex(EscapedRegex(literal).string());
EntireRegexMatch(literal, pattern).text(); // "price: $5.00"

Description#

EscapedRegex converts arbitrary text into one literal Dialect 1 expression. The result remains literal even when RegexFlag.verbose is selected.

Public API#

object EscapedRegex#

object EscapedRegex

Text as a regex that matches exactly that text: Regex(EscapedRegex("1+1").string()).

EscapedRegex.EscapedRegex#

EscapedRegex(origin is string)

The literal pattern for origin.
